name: mdshare
title: mdshare — Free markdown sharing with AI integration
description: Upload markdown, get shareable links, collaborate. Upload, read, update documents, manage comments, generate share links — all via MCP tools. Admin credentials stay local. No login required. The same npm package is also a command line (npx mdshare-mcp --help).

remotes.note: Read only, by share link. Refuses admin links; stores and logs no keys.
